verdict.rationale: Rippling documents user-built custom workflows that trigger automatically on events, such as bonus-payment reminders or a Slack alert fired by a Zendesk ticket. It also offers set-and-forget automations like auto-provisioning and deprovisioning across the employee lifecycle, plus Rippling AI that reviews dependent documents and approves coverage without manual intervention. missing for 10: detailed docs on the workflow builder (trigger types, schedules, conditions, monitoring of background runs), evidence of AI-driven or agentic automation authoring beyond fixed AI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
